raw_answer_text:
A1: The switch learns from the source address of every frame it receives, since the flowchart always performs "Learn source MAC" before the destination lookup, regardless of the lookup outcome.
A2: It associates the source MAC address (SA) with the ingress port on which the frame arrived.
A3: Whether an entry for the destination MAC is found in the MAC table — if found, forward out the single learned port; if not, flood.
A4: It floods the frame to all ports in the VLAN; the ingress port is always excluded.
A5: NOT STATED
A6: When the egress (learned) port is the same as the ingress port.
A7: NOT STATED
A8: NOT STATED
